linework.observation: Bold clean contours define crew, instruments, chart table and pipe runs.

colour.observation: FAIL: intense saturated red lights and reflections cover most room surfaces, outside the restrained palette.

shading.observation: Soft cel shadows remain visible, but large red glow creates excessive gradients.

character_construction.observation: Supporting crew have full faces and hair; no protagonist appears.

backgrounds.observation: Enclosed sonar room with multiple stations and no exterior opening.

finish.observation: Illustrated room is coherent, though the red wash overpowers detail.

identity.observation: No bald protagonist is present; all people read as supporting crew.

content.observation: Operators work at sonar and chart stations in an enclosed submarine space.

composition.observation: Wide ensemble frame establishes crew activity and room layout.

regions.people_faces: Five dark-haired supporting crew with full faces; no protagonist.
regions.foreground_props: Sonar controls, map, papers and handsets.
regions.architecture: Pipe-filled room, consoles and watertight door.
regions.distance: Layered stations and crew establish room scale.
regions.lighting: Saturated red glow across ceiling and panels needs localized indicators and neutral cream work lights.

correction: Keep the supporting crew at their stations and the same enclosed control-room composition. Replace the all-over red lighting with subdued cream task lights and muted steel tones; use only a few small dim red indicators. Preserve hair and normal faces for all crew and the existing 2D style.
